import os, tempfile
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression, LinearRegression
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
os.chdir(tempfile.mkdtemp())
pd.DataFrame({"height": [110,115,120,125,118,130,112,128,122,116], "age": [5,6,6,7,6,7,5,7,6,6],
              "won_race": [0,0,1,1,0,1,0,1,1,0]}).to_csv("class.csv", index=False)
df = pd.read_csv("class.csv")
X = df[["height", "age"]]
y = df["won_race"]
train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.2)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=0)
for model in [LogisticRegression(), DecisionTreeClassifier()]:
    model.fit(X, y)
    X_new = pd.DataFrame({"height": [127], "age": [7]})
    assert model.predict(X_new).shape == (1,)
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    y_pred = model.predict(X_test)
    a = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred); s = model.score(X_test, y_test)
    assert 0 <= a <= 1 and abs(a - s) < 1e-9
assert len(X_test) == 2
LinearRegression().fit(X, df["height"])
km = KMeans(n_clusters=3, n_init=10, random_state=0).fit(X)
assert len(set(km.labels_)) == 3
KMeans(n_clusters=3)
print("ml ok")
